summary.name: Spark Mail
summary.one_liner: Spark is a cross-platform email client that uses priority sorting, filtering, and focus tools to cut inbox noise.
use_cases: Sorting important emails from newsletters and notifications
Managing multiple email accounts in one inbox
Delegating and collaborating on email with a team
summary.what_it_does: Spark is an email client that aims to surface important messages and reduce distractions. Priority and Pin functions highlight key contacts, and Group by Sender bundles mail from the same sender. Gatekeeper screens and blocks emails from unwanted senders, while Mute threads auto-archives threads that are no longer relevant. Newsletter and Notification inboxes are automated, and features like Set Aside, Done Marker, Send Later, and Reminders help manage follow-up. The page also describes it as syncing multiple email accounts across devices and supporting team collaboration on composing and delegating email.
notable: Priority and Pin functions with Group by Sender for inbox triage
Gatekeeper screens and blocks emails from unwanted senders
Team collaboration: compose, delegate, and manage email with colleagues
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page; the awesome-mac listing marks it as Freeware
Platform list beyond macOS and iOS is not specified on the page
